units.k_r_A_s: A/s in dr/dt = V_m k_r (C - C_r)

_meta.note: null = not found in accessible literature. CdSe gamma is a fitted value for capped dots; the other gammas are bare low-index facet DFT values (upper bounds for capped dots). Vm derived as a^3/4 from handbook lattice constants (Madelung, Semiconductors: Data Handbook, Springer 2004). See literature_classical_params.md.

sources.gamma: Bullen & Mulvaney, Nano Lett. 4, 2303 (2004), doi:10.1021/nl0496724; fitted, capped, ODE ~265 C; abstract prints 'J/cm2', read as J/m2
sources.C_inf: Talapin et al., J. Phys. Chem. B 105, 12278 (2001), doi:10.1021/jp012229m; C_flat = 1e-2 mol/m3 in the parameter table of Talapin's PhD thesis (Hamburg 2002)
sources.k_r: Bullen & Mulvaney 2004: deposition rate constant 2.2e-6 cm/s at ~265 C, converted to A/s
sources.control: Bullen 2004; van Embden et al., J. Phys. Chem. C 113, 16342 (2009); Rempel et al., JACS 131, 4479 (2009); Prins...Hens, Nano Lett. 21, 2487 (2021)
sources.Vm: derived, ZB a = 6.052 A; Talapin used 3.29e-5 m3/mol (wurtzite) = 54.6 A3

flags.D: assumed in the source; probably 1e2-1e3 times below DOSY-type solute values
flags.alternatives: gamma 0.125 (Talapin, assumed) and 0.44 (Fanelli 2021, model input); bare calorimetric 1.31 hydrated / 1.65 anhydrous (Xu, Zhou, Navrotsky, J. Mater. Res. 2011); C_inf 5.5e-5 M (Fanelli fit)

sources.C_inf: not found; the ~1 mM thiourea nucleation threshold at 240 C (Hamachi et al., Chem. Sci. 10, 6539 (2019)) is not C_inf
sources.control: assumed by analogy to CdSe/PbS; Hendricks 2015 and Hamachi 2019 show conversion-limited nucleation, but did not test the growth regime
assumed; the reactivity-limited / magic-size-cluster literature is qualitative only

sources.gamma: Zhang, Zhang, Tse, Chan, Deng, Zhu, Sci. Rep. 6, 20055 (2016), arXiv:1506.05570: DFT-GGA, bare ZB (110), 23.9 meV/A2

flags.gamma: bare-facet DFT, an upper bound for capped dots; calorimetry gives 1.76 (bare) / 1.25 (hydrated) J/m2 (Subramani...Navrotsky, GCA 2023); oleate-capped surface enthalpy -1.41 J/m2 (Calvin et al., PNAS 2024)

sources.control: assumed; no data; growth is anisotropic and involves aggregation, so a classical model is questionable

sources.gamma: not found. 0.58 J/m2 for (110) appears only in an unverified secondary source; the oleate-capped surface enthalpy is -3.71 J/m2 (Calvin et al., PNAS 121, e2307633121 (2024))
sources.k_r: not found; Wang...Segets, Chem. Eng. Sci. 2023, doi:10.1016/j.ces.2023.119062, fitted gamma, k and Ea but is paywalled
sources.control: McMurtry...Owen, Chem. Mater. 32, 4358 (2020) (size-dependent growth, continuous nucleation); Wang/Segets 2023 (reaction-limited PBE)

sources.gamma: Leitsmann & Bechstedt, arXiv:cond-mat/0611521 (2006): DFT-LDA, bare relaxed (110), 40.5 meV/A2
sources.control: Kim, Park, Jeong, Nat. Commun. 12, 3013 (2021) (diffusion-limited growth model with continuous cluster supply); Peng, Wickham, Alivisatos, JACS 120, 5343 (1998)

flags.control: modelling assumption under continuous supply; growth after a single injection is ripening-dominated

sources.gamma: Moll, Kley, Pehlke, Scheffler, PRB 54, 8844 (1996), arXiv:mtrl-th/9607005: DFT-LDA, bare (110), 52 meV/A2; fracture experiment 0.86 J/m2 (Messmer & Bilello 1981)
Zhang et al., Sci. Rep. 6, 20055 (2016): DFT-GGA, bare (110), 46.3 meV/A2
Mathew et al., J. Chem. Phys. 140, 084106 (2014), arXiv:1310.4242 (values via MPInterfaces, arXiv:1602.07784): DFT-PBE, bare (100), 24 meV/A2
sources.C_inf: Wang, Xing, Wei, Wang, Wang, Shen, ACS Omega 6, 3701 (2021), doi:10.1021/acsomega.0c05223 (fitted c1,inf)
sources.D: Abecassis et al., Chem. Sci. 13, 4977 (2022), doi:10.1039/d1sc06134h: DOSY of Pb oleate in hexadecane at 110 C, 3.6e-10 m2/s
sources.k_r: not reported as k_r; Abecassis 2022 fit G = v_m k_G C / r^alpha with alpha = 1 and k_G = 3.46e-11 m2/s
sources.control: Abecassis 2022; Campos et al., Chem. Sci. 13, 4555 (2022), doi:10.1039/d1sc06098h
sources.Vm: derived, a = 5.936 A; Abecassis used 31.5e-6 m3/mol

flags.gamma: bare-facet DFT, an upper bound for capped dots
